title: fix(mcp): MCP Apps time out in Safari and the macOS app
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: MCP Apps show a blank panel and time out in Safari and macOS WebKit when their sandbox iframe is attached before navigation.

## User Impact

MCP Apps initialize despite WebKit omitting the iframe referrer. Parent-message authorization and the Control UI's no-referrer privacy policy remain intact.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared sandbox binds its parent from the browser-reported nearest ancestor origin, retaining the referrer fallback for browsers without that API. It still requires an HTTP(S) origin, rejects opaque parents, checks message source and origin, and sends replies only to the bound origin. This repairs the existing shared owner without adding a setting or changing the bridge protocol.

Thanks to @anmol0b for the fix and browser reproduction.

**Before landing:** this security-sensitive path requires maintainer security approval for the final head.

## Evidence

- Maintainer regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/mcp-app-sandbox-http.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` fails on the base at `invalid MCP App sandbox parent` (1 failed, 2 passed; 80.19s wall time). With the fix and `src/agents/mcp-ui-resource.test.ts`, all 17 tests pass (193.97s total wall time). After merging main, the same 17 tests pass on final head `49b5571b098e7621e91ffd868984a4606330f421` (264.76s wall time; new regression 47ms). The regression serves the production sandbox shell through the HTTP listener and executes its bootstrap with an empty referrer; it also rejects an opaque parent.
- Exact-head CI passed: [run 40242929706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40242929706), all 63 jobs completed without failure for `49b5571b098e7621e91ffd868984a4606330f421`. The separate security approval remains pending.
- Independent Codex autoreview found no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Targeted core oxlint, oxfmt, and `git diff --check` pass. The owner and tested paths are unchanged between the proof base and current main.
- Contributor live proof: an isolated Gateway and synthetic Proof App time out on the base in WebKit, then initialize with this patch. Chromium remains working. System Safari also renders the App. Sibling/popup injection and parent-navigation controls retain the message-authority boundary; deliberately removing the checks makes the negative control fail.
- Not live-tested here: the macOS app's embedded WebView and the reporter's HTTPS topology; the existing isolated browser proof was retained instead of creating another harness.
- Production +5/-3 (net +2), tests +45/-0. The small increase documents the WebKit behavior and keeps the existing fallback; no unrelated cleanup is needed.

Before (synthetic Proof App):

![WebKit MCP App times out before the fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b39b63f-bf62-4925-9db8-37af54b84883)

After (synthetic Proof App):

![WebKit MCP App initializes after the fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/666ebfd5-3e27-4e70-aa18-6253c7bac681)

Closes #164447
